fnol_text: My name is Felix Laurent and I live at 500 Hawthorn Drive, Dover, DE 19984. You can reach me on (555) 645-1734 or felix.laurent@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 25 April 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00156. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Laurent on (555) 645-1734 to acknowledge the claim. Felix confirmed the loss date as 25 April 2025.
Site visit to 500 Hawthorn Drive. Neighbour Mateo Moreau was present and confirmed the timeline.
Felix sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
